# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 4 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Sinaiticus (ch 1-31) / P.Mich. 130 (ch 32+), Shepherd of Hermas 4 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_004_page_001.jpg

---

## Vision 1, Chapter 4

**1** Twenty days after that first vision, my friends, I received another one — a foreshadowing of the great tribulation that is coming. **2** I was out walking on a country lane about ten stades from the main road, in rough and hard-to-reach terrain. **3** As I walked by myself, I was asking the Lord to complete all the revelations and visions he had been showing me through his holy church — to strengthen me and grant repentance to all his servants who had gone astray — so that his great and glorious name might be honored, since he had considered me worthy of seeing such wonders. **4** As I was praising and thanking him, I heard something like a voice respond: "Don't waver in your faith, Hermas." I thought to myself: "How could I possibly waver, after God himself has established me in this way, after seeing all these glorious things?" **5** A little further along the road — and you won't believe what I saw, friends — a massive cloud of dust suddenly rose up, reaching toward the sky. I thought, "Must be a herd of cattle kicking up dust." But it was only about a stade away. **6** As the dust kept rising, I had a feeling this was something more than natural. The sun broke through briefly, and there it was — a massive creature, like some enormous sea-monster, with fiery locusts pouring out of its mouth. It was enormous — roughly a hundred feet tall — with a head shaped like a large clay pot. **7** I broke down and started begging the Lord to save me. Then I remembered the word I had heard: "Don't waver in your faith, Hermas." **8** So I did it, friends — I put on faith like armor, called to mind everything great and glorious that the Lord had shown me, and I walked straight toward the beast. It was coming at me with such terrifying speed and force that it could have leveled an entire city. **9** But when I got close, the enormous creature just lay down on the ground and did nothing but stick out its tongue. It didn't move a muscle until I had walked right past it. **10** The beast had four colors painted on its head: black, then a fiery blood-red, then gold, and finally white.

---

*PNEUMA note: "Don't waver in your faith" for me dipsyches — the double-minded / double-souled person is someone who vacillates between trust and doubt.*
